facts.fact: The northern Etruscan gate is also known as the Arch of Augustus. Its monumental form includes two tapering trapezoidal towers; Roman inscriptions and a Renaissance loggia show later layers.
facts.location: Main description of the gate and its later additions.

facts.fact: The inscription Augusta Perusia is associated with reconstruction after the Perusine War. The article distinguishes later Roman inscriptions from the gate’s Etruscan origin.
facts.location: Description of inscriptions following the gate’s construction history.
